hardwareFingerprint.en: Residual local-only generate_user_id() (PostHog hard-disabled, never sent)

oneLiner.en: Local backend, frontend, and release scripts unconditionally disable PostHog and Sentry (release script fails if keys appear), resulting in zero active telemetry.

title.en: Local telemetry hard-disabled; residual local-only machine ID generator

summary.en: `AnalyticsConfig::new()` and `SentrySource::dsn()` unconditionally return `None`; `scripts/release-local.sh:256-267` blocks builds containing keys.
